registered_acceptance.prefix_gate: For adjacent finest resolutions: at most one difference in prefix abort count, at most two individual outcome changes among 28; median paired peak wrist and contact-impulse relative differences <=20%, with every outlier and exposure difference reported. Positive fixture/finger controls, native CPU replay and unchanged coarse reference must pass.
registered_acceptance.extension: Run 960 Hz once if 240/480 fails any material outcome or load-stability margin. This is a diagnostic extension, not a claim that three timesteps prove convergence.
registered_acceptance.training_gate: A prefix pass alone does not enable substantial training. At the selected finest stable pair rerun frozen learned direct, learned continuation and unchanged retry for complete30s jobs; no more than one completion-count difference and two individual outcome differences per arm, no forbidden events, retained force/dwell/observation contracts. Alternatively identify and independently justify a physical-model or API correction, register it, and rerun affected common controls.
registered_acceptance.stop: Spend at most three distinct explanation-driven probe variants or two hours of simulator diagnosis after this prefix series. If no interpretable force-limited task is established, reject the current comparative-training premise for this cycle and retain a concrete numerical-sensitivity result; do not spend large training merely to produce candidate scores.

scope_and_limitations: Prospective change to a shared controller condition; previous aborts retain their original outcomes.
Requests still active at four seconds are censored. Retain all 28 requests, forbidden events, aborts and native simulation cost.
The interpolated reference introduces hidden actuator state shared by learning arms. Observations and architecture stay fixed.
No assumed compliance calibration, force-filter substitution, removal of difficult cases, hardware transfer or force-certified safety claim.
Original physical/raw20N abort/native replay and float32 precision checks remain required.
Original quaternion generation remains inherited source behavior; quaternion terminal holds, zero gripper commands/targets and Cartesian reference/clamp/reward/hold receive native checks.
All28requests remain in denominators. The active-prefix support floor is separate from stability, stall eligibility and success.
Only common-active applied actions are compared across conditions; reference states and physical trajectories intentionally differ.
This final cause-test variant can earn only full-job validation. It provides no ordinary-versus-recovery-teaching result.
